description: Deploy one exact Fisora main-branch commit to the production EC2 instance.

TargetSha.description: Exact Git commit SHA to deploy.

runCommand: if [ "$workflow_blob" = "$legacy_workflow_blob" ]; then legacy_dirty="$(sudo -u ubuntu git -C "$ROOT_DIR" status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)"; if [ "$legacy_dirty" = " M $workflow_path" ]; then stat -c 'FISORA_LEGACY_PATH_BEFORE owner=%U:%G mode=%a path=%n' "$ROOT_DIR/.github" "$ROOT_DIR/.github/workflows" "$ROOT_DIR/$workflow_path" >&2; git -c safe.directory="$ROOT_DIR" -C "$ROOT_DIR" restore --source=HEAD --worktree -- "$workflow_path"; chown ubuntu:ubuntu "$ROOT_DIR/.github" "$ROOT_DIR/.github/workflows" "$ROOT_DIR/$workflow_path"; stat -c 'FISORA_LEGACY_PATH_AFTER owner=%U:%G mode=%a path=%n' "$ROOT_DIR/.github" "$ROOT_DIR/.github/workflows" "$ROOT_DIR/$workflow_path" >&2; echo "FISORA_DEPLOY_REPAIRED reason=known_legacy_workflow_blob blob=$legacy_workflow_blob"; fi; fi

if [ -n "$dirty" ]; then echo 'FISORA_DEPLOY_BLOCKED reason=tracked_worktree_changes' >&2; printf '%s\n' "$dirty" >&2; if [ -f .github/workflows/deploy-production.yml ]; then printf 'FISORA_DIRTY_WORKTREE_BLOB=' >&2; sudo -u ubuntu git -C "$ROOT_DIR" hash-object .github/workflows/deploy-production.yml >&2; printf 'FISORA_DIRTY_HEAD_BLOB=' >&2; sudo -u ubuntu git -C "$ROOT_DIR" rev-parse HEAD:.github/workflows/deploy-production.yml >&2; fi; exit 20; fi
sudo -u ubuntu git -C "$ROOT_DIR" fetch origin main
sudo -u ubuntu git -C "$ROOT_DIR" cat-file -e '{{ TargetSha }}^{commit}' || { echo 'FISORA_DEPLOY_BLOCKED reason=target_commit_missing' >&2; exit 21; }
sudo -u ubuntu git -C "$ROOT_DIR" merge-base --is-ancestor '{{ TargetSha }}' origin/main || { echo 'FISORA_DEPLOY_BLOCKED reason=target_not_on_origin_main' >&2; exit 22; }
